notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one replaces the keyed stub with a solid Ø6 stub for C-201's wave generator, stops the shaft bore in the hex (DC-600-1 in specs/009), and draws the stub's and shaft bore's press fits and the set-screw bolt's and nut's slip fits. The dimensions and fits are in 630-004_WaveGenCoupler.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
